La commande 'Créer une commande' permet: The "Create Command" command lets you add an action, such as a shortcut to play a radio station. To do this, you can use the "playsong" command, which will be converted to "play" followed by the song number in the Queue.
La configuration des équipements est acc: You can configure the devices from the plugin menu (Plugins menu, Multimedia, then MPD).
La présentation créée par défaut permet: The default layout allows you to perform basic functions. Note the "refresh" button (in the upper-right corner of the widget), which updates the MPD player's status (playlists, current song, etc.). Selecting a playlist populates the MPD queue with the corresponding songs. Selecting a song plays it.
La présentation est réalisée à l'aide de: The layout is created using the Equipment Layout feature (in "Advanced Configuration").
Le bon fonctionnement du plugin suppose: For the plugin to work properly, the MPD server must be running.
Le plugin permet d'exécuter les fonction: The plugin allows you to perform basic functions (loading playlists, playback, volume, etc.) from Jeedom. The plugin uses the mpc utility to execute commands on the MPD server, whether it is local or remote. The mpc package is installed when the plugin is activated (GitHub link <HTTPS://github.com/MusicPlayerDaemon/mpc>).
